_comment: Structural family coefficients per STRUCTURE_DAMAGE_SPEC.md §3. plateCoef contributes to Plates max; threshWeight contributes to weighted-avg Threshold; chipN = damage points consumed per material unit chipped; nativeResists are inherent damage-type modifiers; chipOrder = sort position in the chip queue (lower = chipped first).

salvage.label: Salvage
salvage.note: Quirk resist = on chip, GM may roll a random quirk (Phase B+)

memetic.label: Memetic
memetic.note: Affects witness/truth rolls, not direct damage. Damage-side behavior is mid-fragility.

ward.label: Ward
ward.note: Resist type is derived from material tags[]: 'hex-resistant', 'qliphothic-resistant', 'curse-resistant', 'blessed'.

sephirotic.label: Sephirotic
sephirotic.note: LOAD-BEARING. Structure cannot transition Breached → Razed while any sephirotic unit remains in BOM. Yesodium / Tree-of-Life Shard live here.

rubbleJitter.note: Locked per spec §4. Asymmetric upside for attacker; rubble comes apart in unkind chunks.
